image_description: A medium shot of a smiling young man standing outdoors on stone steps in front of a red brick building. He is wearing a black academic gown over a dark suit and tie, with a blue scarf or hood visible at the neck. He wears a black square academic cap (mortarboard) with a tassel. His hands are clasped in front of him. Potted plants flank the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the mid-thigh/knee level; the 'ankles' and full length are not visible, so the full-length attribute cannot be verified as present.
The gown exhibits clear bilateral symmetry and the characteristic vertical front opening panels are visible.
The fabric hangs loosely and broadly, successfully hiding the specific shape of the torso and legs beneath.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive wide, bell-shaped academic sleeves are clearly visible and drape significantly past the wrists/hands.
The vertical strips of fabric defining the front opening are distinct and match the taxonomy description.
A shirt collar, tie, and suit jacket lapel are clearly visible underneath the gown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears opaque, heavy, and non-reflective (matte), consistent with traditional gown materials.
There are no specular highlights or shiny patches on the black fabric; light absorption is consistent with matte textile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve extensions hang naturally and extend beyond the subject's wrists.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the garment matches the specific visual features of an academic gown vs generic robe.
Check for edge bleeding between the complex sleeve folds and the background/hands, common in AI generation.
Verify anatomical correctness of hands and arms, ensuring no fusion with the gown or extra digits.
Ensure the subject is properly separated from the brick wall and plants without spatial melting.

focus_areas: Hand anatomy and interaction with gown
Boundary sharpness between gown and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands. AI often struggles with hands clasped in front of dark clothing. Check if fingers merge into the gown or each other. Also verify the mortarboard cap sits physically correctly on the head without floating or clipping through hair.
